title: Stream2Sea Ecostick SPF 40
inactive_section: STREAM2SEA ECOSTICK MINERAL SUNSCREEN SPF 40 AND SPF 40 KIDS Beeswax, Carnauba Wax, Extracts of Green Tea Leaf *, Tulsi Leaf *, Wakame Seaweed *, and Olea Europaea (Olive) Leaf * in Sunflower Seed Oil, Jojoba Esters, Microcrystalline Cellulose, Mixed Tocopherols (Vitamin E), Polyhydroxystearic Acid, Sweet Almond Oil, Sorbitan Olivate, Squalane (Plant-Based). *CERTIFIED ORGANIC INGREDIENTS. STREAM2SEA ECOSTICK MINERAL SUNSCREEN SPF 40 TINT Also contains Iron Oxide (CI 77491, CI 77492, and CI 77499)
